title: Three hundred twenty thousand
logline: The odometer again, two years on: 320,000, no rollover this time, a hand on the wheel, rain. Tuesdays.

panels.composition: Close on a station wagon's dashboard with a mechanical odometer reading 320,000, a man's hand on the wheel at the edge, rain on the windshield.
